title: B2332 – Column Tilt Feedback Potentiometer Circuit Failure
description: Column Tilt Feedback Potentiometer Circuit Failure
symptoms: Check engine light or stored DTC present
Driveability or system warning may accompany this code
causes: Component or circuit fault related to this monitor

Inspect related components and wiring before replacing parts
Clear codes only after repair and confirm monitors complete
keywords: column tilt feedback potentiometer circuit failure
